description.value: The Xeriscape Garden is a public demonstration garden operated by the Regional District of Nanaimo, showcasing water-wise, drought-tolerant landscaping techniques suited to Vancouver Island conditions. Located on Yambury Road, it is a free community resource intended to educate residents about outdoor water conservation. Touring cyclists in the Parksville/Qualicum area may find it a pleasant stop, though on-site cyclist services are unconfirmed.
